dataset: Model-knowledge draft fill for missing standard points (PC/LR/TE)
policy: Every record is draft / model_draft_pending_source_review. Conservative textbook-level content written by Claude from standard TCM education knowledge. Must be verified against WHO SAPL, CloudTCM, and professional textbooks before any promotion. Needling fields are study reference only, not operating instructions.

records.location_zh: 胸部，第 4 肋間隙，乳頭外側 1 寸（前正中線旁開 5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the chest, in the 4th intercostal space, 1 cun lateral to the nipple, 5 cun lateral to the anterior midline.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, regulates qi, dissipates nodules.
records.needling: 沿肋間斜刺或平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；胸壁穴位不可深刺。
contraindications: 胸壁穴位，深刺有氣胸風險；哺乳期與乳部病變處慎用。
danger: Pneumothorax risk if needled deeply — oblique or transverse insertion only.

records.location_zh: 臂前區，腋前紋頭下 2 寸，肱二頭肌長、短頭之間。
records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the arm, 2 cun distal to the anterior axillary fold, between the two heads of biceps brachii.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, invigorates blood in the channel.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 肘前區，肘橫紋上，肱二頭肌腱尺側緣凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the elbow, at the cubital crease, in the depression on the ulnar side of the biceps brachii tendon.
functions_zh: 清熱和胃，鎮驚安神，活血通絡。合水穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, harmonizes the stomach, calms the spirit. He-sea and water point.
records.needling: 直刺 0.8-1 寸，或三稜針點刺出血；避開肱動脈。
contraindications: 深部近肱動脈，針刺須避開血管；出血傾向者慎點刺。
danger: Brachial artery lies medially — avoid the vessel.

records.location_zh: 前臂前區，腕掌側遠端橫紋上 5 寸，掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱之間。
records.location_en: On the anterior forearm, 5 cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.
functions_zh: 寧心安神，清營止血。郄穴。
functions_en: Calms the heart and spirit, cools blood and stops bleeding. Xi-cleft point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 前臂前區，腕掌側遠端橫紋上 3 寸，掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱之間。
records.location_en: On the anterior forearm, 3 cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.
functions_zh: 寬胸和胃，清心安神，截瘧。經金穴。
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, harmonizes the stomach, calms the spirit, interrupts malaria. Jing-river and metal point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 腕前區，腕掌側遠端橫紋中點，掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱之間。
records.location_en: At the midpoint of the palmar wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.
functions_zh: 寧心安神，和營通絡，寬胸和胃。輸土穴、原穴。
functions_en: Calms the heart and spirit, harmonizes the stomach. Shu-stream, earth and yuan-source point.
records.needling: 直刺 0.3-0.5 寸；正中神經位於其深部，出現觸電感即停止進針調整方向。
contraindications: 深部為正中神經，避免強刺激與反覆提插。
danger: Median nerve lies directly beneath — avoid strong stimulation.

records.location_zh: 掌心，第 2、3 掌骨之間偏於第 3 掌骨，握拳屈指時中指尖所指處。
records.location_en: In the center of the palm, between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, closer to the 3rd, where the tip of the middle finger rests when a fist is made.
functions_zh: 清心泄熱，開竅醒神，和胃止嘔。滎火穴。
functions_en: Clears heart heat, revives consciousness, harmonizes the stomach. Ying-spring and fire point.
records.needling: 直刺 0.3-0.5 寸；掌心針感強烈，體弱者慎。
contraindications: 針感強烈，暈針史者慎用。

records.location_zh: 中指末端最高點（中指尖端中央）。
records.location_en: At the center of the tip of the middle finger.
functions_zh: 開竅醒神，清心泄熱。井木穴。
functions_en: Revives consciousness, clears heart heat. Jing-well and wood point.
records.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或三稜針點刺出血。
contraindications: 急救用穴；出血傾向者慎點刺。

records.location_zh: 足大趾末節外側，趾甲角旁開 0.1 寸。
records.location_en: On the lateral side of the distal phalanx of the great toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the toenail.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止淋，回陽救逆。井木穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation, rescues yang. Jing-well and wood point.
records.needling: 斜刺 0.1-0.2 寸，或點刺出血；疝氣、崩漏傳統多用灸。
contraindications: 孕婦慎灸。

records.location_zh: 足背，第 1、2 趾之間，趾蹼緣後方赤白肉際處。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 1st and 2nd toes, proximal to the web margin at the border of the red and white skin.
functions_zh: 清肝瀉火，涼血安神，熄風活絡。滎火穴。
functions_en: Drains liver fire, cools blood, calms the spirit, extinguishes wind. Ying-spring and fire point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 內踝前 1 寸，脛骨前肌腱內側緣凹陷中（商丘與解溪連線之間）。
records.location_en: 1 cun anterior to the medial malleolus, in the depression medial to the tendon of tibialis anterior.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，清瀉濕熱。經金穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, drains damp-heat. Jing-river and metal point.
contraindications: 局部肌腱處避免強力提插。

records.location_zh: 小腿內側，內踝尖上 5 寸，脛骨內側面中央。
records.location_en: On the medial lower leg, 5 cun proximal to the tip of the medial malleolus, at the center of the medial surface of the tibia.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止帶。絡穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation and discharge. Luo-connecting point.
records.needling: 平刺 0.5-0.8 寸（骨面上沿皮刺）。
contraindications: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。

records.location_zh: 小腿內側，內踝尖上 7 寸，脛骨內側面中央。
records.location_en: On the medial lower leg, 7 cun proximal to the tip of the medial malleolus, at the center of the medial surface of the tibia.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止血。郄穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation, stops bleeding. Xi-cleft point.
contraindications: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。

records.location_zh: 膝內側，脛骨內側髁下方，陰陵泉（SP9）後方 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the medial knee, below the medial condyle of the tibia, 1 cun posterior to SP9 Yinlingquan.
functions_en: Dispels cold-damp, unblocks the joint.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 膝內側，屈膝時膝內側橫紋端上方凹陷中，半腱肌、半膜肌止端前緣。
records.location_en: On the medial knee, with the knee flexed, in the depression proximal to the medial end of the popliteal crease, anterior to the insertions of semitendinosus and semimembranosus.
functions_zh: 清利濕熱，補益肝腎，調經止帶。合水穴。
functions_en: Clears damp-heat, supplements liver and kidney, regulates menstruation. He-sea and water point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 大腿內側，髕底上 4 寸，股薄肌與縫匠肌之間。
records.location_en: On the medial thigh, 4 cun proximal to the base of the patella, between gracilis and sartorius.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation, relieves pain, promotes urination.
indications_en: Lumbosacral pain radiating to the lower abdomen
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 大腿內側，氣衝（ST30）直下 3 寸，動脈搏動處內側，長收肌前緣。
records.location_en: On the medial thigh, 3 cun distal to ST30 Qichong, on the anterior border of adductor longus.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，清利下焦濕熱。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, clears damp-heat from the lower burner.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸；避開股動、靜脈。
contraindications: 鄰近股血管，針刺避開搏動處。
danger: Femoral vessels nearby — avoid the pulsating artery.

records.location_zh: 大腿內側，氣衝（ST30）直下 2 寸。
records.location_en: On the medial thigh, 2 cun distal to ST30 Qichong.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation and discharge, frees the lower burner.
records.needling: 直刺 0.8-1 寸；避開股血管。
contraindications: 鄰近股血管，避開搏動處。

records.location_zh: 腹股溝區，恥骨聯合下緣中點旁開 2.5 寸，股動脈搏動處外側。
records.location_en: In the inguinal region, 2.5 cun lateral to the midpoint of the inferior border of the pubic symphysis, lateral to the femoral artery.
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, relieves pain in the inguinal region.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸，必須避開股動脈；傳統多灸少針。
contraindications: 緊鄰股動脈，針刺須先觸清搏動位置並避開；孕婦慎用。
danger: Femoral artery immediately medial — palpate and avoid.

records.location_zh: 側腹部，第 11 肋游離端下際。
records.location_en: On the lateral abdomen, below the free end of the 11th rib.
functions_zh: 疏肝健脾，理氣散結。脾之募穴、臟會。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, fortifies the spleen, dissipates masses. Front-mu of the spleen; hui-meeting of the zang.
records.needling: 斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺 — 右側深部為肝，左側深部為脾。
contraindications: 深部為肝（右）脾（左），肝脾腫大者尤其不可深刺。
danger: Liver (right) and spleen (left) lie deep to this point — no deep insertion, especially with organomegaly.

records.location_zh: 無名指末節尺側，指甲角旁開 0.1 寸。
records.location_en: On the ulnar side of the distal phalanx of the ring finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail.
functions_zh: 清熱解表，開竅醒神。井金穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, releases the exterior, revives consciousness. Jing-well and metal point.
records.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血。
contraindications: 出血傾向者慎點刺。

records.location_zh: 手背，第 4、5 指之間，指蹼緣後方赤白肉際處。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, between the 4th and 5th fingers, proximal to the web margin at the border of the red and white skin.
functions_en: Clears the head and eyes, regulates the triple burner. Ying-spring and water point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 手背，第 4、5 掌骨間，第 4 掌指關節近端凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, between the 4th and 5th metacarpals, in the depression proximal to the 4th metacarpophalangeal joint.
functions_zh: 清熱通絡，開竅益聰。輸木穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, benefits the ears. Shu-stream and wood point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 腕背側遠端橫紋上，指總伸肌腱尺側緣凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression ulnar to the tendon of extensor digitorum.
functions_zh: 清熱通絡，益陰增液。原穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, unblocks the channel, engenders fluids. Yuan-source point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 3 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
records.location_en: On the posterior forearm, 3 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_zh: 清利三焦，通腑降逆。經火穴。
functions_en: Clears the triple burner, moves the bowels. Jing-river and fire point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 3 寸，尺骨橈側緣。
records.location_en: On the posterior forearm, 3 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, on the radial border of the ulna.
functions_zh: 清利三焦，安神定志。郄穴。
functions_en: Clears the triple burner, calms the spirit. Xi-cleft point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 4 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
records.location_en: On the posterior forearm, 4 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_en: Relaxes the sinews, opens the voice, benefits the ears.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 前臂後區，肘尖（鷹嘴）下 5 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
records.location_en: On the posterior forearm, 5 cun distal to the tip of the olecranon, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, clears the throat.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 肘後區，肘尖（鷹嘴）上 1 寸凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the posterior elbow, in the depression 1 cun proximal to the tip of the olecranon.
functions_zh: 行氣散結，安神通絡。合土穴。
functions_en: Moves qi, dissipates nodules, calms the spirit. He-sea and earth point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 臂後區，肘尖上 2 寸（天井上 1 寸）。
records.location_en: On the posterior arm, 2 cun proximal to the tip of the olecranon, 1 cun above TE10.
functions_en: Clears heat, dispels wind, unblocks the channel.
indications_en: Shoulder and arm pain limiting elevation
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 臂後區，清冷淵與臑會連線的中點（肘尖上 5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the posterior arm, midway between TE11 and TE13, about 5 cun proximal to the olecranon.
functions_en: Clears heat, calms the spirit, unblocks the channel.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 臂後區，肩峰角下 3 寸，三角肌後下緣。
records.location_en: On the posterior arm, 3 cun distal to the angle of the acromion, on the posteroinferior border of deltoid.
functions_en: Transforms phlegm, dissipates nodules, relieves pain.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 肩峰角與肱骨大結節之間，臂外展時肩髃（LI15）後方凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the shoulder, in the depression posterior to LI15 when the arm is abducted, between the acromial angle and the greater tubercle of the humerus.
functions_en: Dispels wind-damp, unblocks the channel.
records.needling: 直刺 0.8-1.2 寸（向極泉方向）。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 肩胛區，肩胛骨上角上方凹陷中（肩井與曲垣之間）。
records.location_en: In the scapular region, in the depression superior to the superior angle of the scapula, between GB21 and SI13.
functions_en: Dispels wind-damp, unblocks the channel.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可向前下深刺 — 肺尖在其深部。
contraindications: 深部近肺尖，深刺有氣胸風險。
danger: Apex of the lung lies deep — no deep insertion (pneumothorax risk).

records.location_zh: 頸部，胸鎖乳突肌後緣，約平下頜角處。
records.location_en: On the neck, at the posterior border of sternocleidomastoid, level with the angle of the mandible.
functions_en: Clears the head, brightens the eyes, unblocks the channel.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸，避免深刺與強刺激。
contraindications: 頸部血管神經豐富，控制深度。

records.location_zh: 耳垂後方，乳突與下頜角之間的凹陷中。
records.location_en: Posterior to the earlobe, in the depression between the mastoid process and the angle of the mandible.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, dispels wind, drains heat.
records.needling: 直刺 0.8-1 寸；深部有面神經幹與血管，避免粗暴提插。
contraindications: 深部為面神經與頸部血管，控制方向與深度。
danger: Facial nerve trunk and deep vessels beneath — gentle technique only.

records.location_zh: 耳後乳突中央，角孫（TE20）至翳風（TE17）沿耳輪弧形連線的下 1/3 與上 2/3 交點。
records.location_en: At the center of the mastoid, at the junction of the lower third and upper two-thirds of the curve from TE20 to TE17 behind the ear.
functions_en: Extinguishes wind, relieves spasm, benefits the ears.
records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸，或點刺出血。
contraindications: 出血傾向者慎點刺。

records.location_zh: 耳後，角孫（TE20）至翳風（TE17）弧形連線的上 1/3 與下 2/3 交點。
records.location_en: Behind the ear, at the junction of the upper third and lower two-thirds of the curve from TE20 to TE17.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, drains heat, settles fright.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，折耳向前，耳尖直上入髮際處。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the ear apex within the hairline when the ear is folded forward.
functions_en: Clears heat, reduces swelling, dispels wind.
records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；痄腮傳統常用燈心草灸（燈火灸）。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 耳區，耳屏上切跡與下頜骨髁突之間，張口呈凹陷處。
records.location_en: In front of the ear, in the depression between the supratragic notch and the condylar process of the mandible, located with the mouth open.
functions_en: Opens the portals, benefits the ears, drains heat.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭側部，鬢髮後緣，耳廓根前方，顳淺動脈的後緣。
records.location_en: On the side of the head, posterior to the temporal hairline, anterior to the auricular root, posterior to the superficial temporal artery.
functions_en: Dispels wind, unblocks the channel, reduces swelling.
records.needling: 避開顳淺動脈，斜刺或平刺 0.3-0.5 寸。
contraindications: 緊鄰顳淺動脈，須先觸清搏動並避開。
danger: Superficial temporal artery adjacent — palpate and avoid.

records.location_zh: 面部，眉梢凹陷處。
records.location_en: On the face, in the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow.
functions_en: Clears the head, brightens the eyes, dispels wind.
records.needling: 平刺 0.5-1 寸；傳統列為禁灸穴。
contraindications: 傳統禁灸；局部皮膚破損時避開。
